patthana24.2:1.1: Nahetuṃ nahetusampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu hetusampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cattāri.
patthana24.2:2.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu hetuvippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana24.2:3.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuñceva naahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu hetu ceva sahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.2:4.1: Nanahetuṃ naahetukañceva nanahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu sahetuko ceva na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.2:5.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuñceva nahetuvippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.2:6.1: Nanahetuṃ nahetuvippayuttañceva nanahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu hetusampayutto ceva na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.2:7.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nahetu sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana24.2:8.1: Nahetuṃ nahetuṃ naahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nahetu ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
